C1.worst_defect: The hero says what it is and offers 'Live demo' / 'Quick start', but the facts that rule a shop out for someone comparing it with Square or Shopify POS (no integrated card terminal, no cash drawer, iPad and phones 'not tested yet', Postgres only) sit two screens down under 'Before you start'. Nothing near the top says who should not use it.
C1.where: home/desktop/01 hero vs home/desktop/02 'Before you start'

C2.worst_defect: The demo is ahead of anything you can install, and the newest plugin is six weeks old. The changelog's last plugin release is '0.3.0 (2026-10-06)', 'Released the same day as 0.2.0, a few hours later', with nothing since. Meanwhile the demo refunds at the till and takes a customer note ('On plugin 0.3.0, Order details has no customer note. On the live demo, type a Customer note'), and the site gives no next version or date for either. The home 'Live demo or your own store' table lists the refund gap but leaves out the customer-note gap.
C2.where: changelog/desktop/01; at-the-till.txt 'Order details'; home/desktop/02 comparison table

C3.worst_defect: A known bug in the shipped plugin is left for the reader to work around by hand. The device-key role 'has the step 4 permissions except ReadOrder, so add ReadOrder to that role yourself'. The changelog even calls this 'Not in the release notes', and no 0.3.1 fixes it. A developer following the device-key path has to catch this caveat or the till's order history is refused.
C3.where: quick-start 'Optional: a device key for each till'; changelog/desktop/01 0.2.0 last bullet

C4.worst_defect: Connect a till's 'Give each cashier their own account' contradicts itself in one step. It says to 'Use the vendurepos-pos-till role … or create a role with TallyPosSell, … and ReadOrder', then 'On plugin 0.3.0 that role has no ReadOrder: add it yourself'. The same ReadOrder caveat is repeated across quick-start, connect-a-till (twice) and changelog instead of living in one place.
C4.where: connect-a-till.txt 'Give each cashier their own account'

C5.worst_defect: In 'What it does today', the first two features are boxed cards with buttons and the other eight are plain heading-and-paragraph pairs, so the section changes style halfway. The 'Refund a sale at the till' row of the comparison table holds a four-line paragraph while every other row says 'Yes'.
C5.where: home/desktop/01 bottom to home/desktop/02 top; home/desktop/02 table

C6.worst_defect: Small: on the home page's phone header, Quick start and At the till are hidden behind the chevron and only 'Docs' and 'Live demo' show. Everything else reflows cleanly: the comparison table stacks per row, code wraps, and there is no overflow on any page (tech.json overflowX false).

C7.worst_defect: Small: the share card (og-image.png) says 'Point of sale for Vendure … every sale lands in Vendure once' with no 'pre-release' or 'open-source' mark, so a link shared in Slack reads as a finished product. The SoftwareApplication JSON-LD has no softwareVersion. Everything else holds: Lighthouse 98/100/100/100, a real 404 status, llms.txt, a working search API and a sitemap.

overall_worst.defect: As a sceptic advising a client: the proof and the demo describe code that has not shipped, while the installable plugin has not moved since 2026-10-06. The 'Read the acceptance test' and 'Read the 200-send test' buttons link to github.com/vendurepos/app/blob/main/…, not the plugin-v0.3.0 tag. The demo refunds at the till and takes customer notes that no released plugin supports. A known ReadOrder bug from 0.2.0 is documented as a workaround on three pages instead of fixed. That reads like a project whose demo outruns its releases, and the site gives no next-release date or maintenance signal to answer it.
overall_worst.where: home/desktop/01 'Read the acceptance test' / 'Read the 200-send test' (tech.json links); changelog/desktop/01; at-the-till.txt 'Order details'
overall_worst.fix: Point the two test links at the plugin-v0.3.0 tag. Add a short 'Next plugin release' note at the top of the changelog that names what is on main but unreleased (till refunds, customer note, ReadOrder in the role) and when it is expected.
